title: Commission presents updated EU Emissions Trading System benchmarks for consultation*
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 11 May 2026 The European Commission has today proposed the updated European Union Emissions Trading System (EU ETS) benchmark values for 2026-2030, which will now be open to public and Member State consultation before adoption.
